description: This is a PHP source file for the 'reqMgrSystemEdit' component of the TestLink project. It handles the creation, editing, and deletion of request management system entries, rendering GUIs, initializing scripts, validating input, and managing access rights.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the graphical user interface based on the action, using Smarty templates or redirects.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes the script variables, including argument parsing and GUI setup.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments based on a whitelist.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with necessary data, such as related test projects, based on input arguments.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to access the request manager system management interface.
